The latch is never decremented in this class, so the application remains running while the Swing UI is open. This launcher targets the com.poc MVC-style prototype, distinct from websocket.Main and the Eclipse launch configuration's websocket.Main target.

files.summary: Builds a Swing form for Allegro-style person and payment details and connects it to a WebSocket endpoint. Incoming messages are routed to either the form fields or a text area.
files.description: This standalone prototype combines a Swing user interface, a Tyrus WebSocket client endpoint, and JSON-P parsing in one class. It expects a server at localhost port 1337 and maps message targets to form updates. Its UI and data shape overlap conceptually with the Node/Vue mock but it is a separate implementation; the repository does not establish a complete integrated deployment.
business_rules: Messages targeted at textarea populate the text area; messages targeted at textfield populate person and payment fields.
Gender options are mutually exclusive through a Swing ButtonGroup, with female selected by default.
The client expects person properties and payment properties such as IBAN, BIC, and validity start date in the received JSON.

files.summary: Implements a mock person search form, result and payment selection tables, and WebSocket transfer of selected values or text.
files.description: Search presents German-labeled person/address inputs, a result list, payment-recipient choices, a transfer button, and a text area. Search data is a hard-coded in-memory sample set rather than a remote search API; the form matches results when any supported populated criterion matches, using case-insensitive partial comparisons for names, city, street, and house number and equality for postal code. It sends selected-result and text-area messages to localhost:1337 using a target/content JSON envelope, and the component's WebSocket connection is initiated on mount.
business_rules: A result is included when any populated supported criterion matches (OR semantics), not only when every entered criterion matches.
Names, city, street, and house number use case-insensitive substring matching; postal code uses equality.
The selected payment recipient replaces the result's payment-recipient list in the outgoing textfield payload.
Changes to the internal text area are sent with the textarea target.

files.summary: Defines a separate Java 17 Maven test project using Cucumber, JUnit 5, RestAssured, AssertJ, and logging.
files.description: The test-project descriptor configures the API test suite dependencies, Java 17 compilation, and Surefire runner selection. The project is isolated under analysis_output/api-test-generator and targets a localhost POST service; its location and project documentation identify it as an API test generator/output artifact, but its test sources and runner are present and were included in the analysis.
